lines.text: Defence and tech news reaches you from everywhere: news sites, colleagues, and the group chat.
Which of it is true? Which of it matters? Sorting it out by hand can take hours.
Meet News Pulse. The three stories that matter, checked.
It collects news from trusted defence and technology sources. An AI agent checks every story against independent and official sources. And only the three that matter reach you.
Every story comes with a clear verdict, a two-line summary, and the reasons behind it.
Got a forwarded link? Paste it in, and News Pulse checks it for you.
This one? Likely fake. And it tells you why.
It caught every planted fake in our tests. And it shows its reasoning, so you make the call.
News Pulse. Three stories. Checked. In minutes, not hours.
